approval.reference: workbench/tasks/historical_return_observation/DESIGN_REQUEST.md: WB-02 user Goal; Task design and G1 acceptance only, no live market execution approval

goal: Describe the historical N-trading-session trailing cumulative return distribution for explicitly specified supported index subjects and inclusive historical sample windows, retaining statistical results, coverage, limitations and execution evidence.
scope: Published descriptive trailing_cumulative_return_v1 index case only. WB-02 implements G1 Backend Ready and evidence preservation only. No forward returns, predictions, strategies, trading recommendations, live Research or paid data access is authorized by Task approval.
required_inputs: Before research execution: explicit full canonical supported index_code identities; no guessed code, suffix, stock or futures binding. Syntax alone does not prove provider membership or readiness.
Before research execution: explicit strictly positive non-bool integer horizon(s) H in trading_sessions.

Before research execution: explicit inclusive start_date/end_date sample window(s), start <= end, no future end date in Asia/Shanghai; anchors are return-ending sessions, with warm-up preceding the window as needed.

Before research execution: explicit ordered analysis requests with unique request_id and supported method/spec parameters: quantile points or interval_count edges and decimal_ratio unit. No invented statistic or automatic bins.
Before research execution: explicit metric=trailing_cumulative_return_v1, metric_parameters={} and on_job_failure=continue or stop; missing inputs require explicit resolution before execution.

Before research execution: user authorization for actual capability invocation, including any acquisition, cache writes and paid-data access. Record the published case's source and missing-data policy; unresolved intent conflicts must be resolved, never replaced with a default.

For a G1-only Run: backend target and finite timeout, using the documented operational defaults if not overridden; original_request must explicitly state readiness-only scope. Research inputs may remain unresolved and must not be invented.
allowed_capabilities: G1: read-only GET /openapi.json on the existing repository backend; no Research operation is invoked by the readiness checker.

Operator/Agent may explicitly start a stopped backend using poetry run lab serve backend from the repository root, then recheck; never terminate, replace or take ownership of an existing user-owned process.

G3 future implementation: published GET /research/capabilities and GET /research/capabilities/{id}, or public market_research.descriptive.capabilities list_capabilities/get_capability; discovery does not establish live readiness.
G4 future implementation: public market_research.descriptive.execution ResearchPlan/preview_plan or POST /research/preview, under their owners' contracts; no market I/O in preview.

G5 future implementation and separate execution authorization: public market_research.descriptive.execution execute_batch or POST /research/execute, delegating to published Research and Statistics semantics. No direct provider, private module or cache access.
Existing workbench/run_store.py create, artifact, event, gate and read operations for exact Task snapshots and same-Run evidence.

research_meaning.horizon: Positive integer trading sessions on the published SSE calendar, never calendar days or available-price row offsets.
research_meaning.population: Inclusive window of ending-session anchors; preserve eligible, unavailable and excluded populations, coverage, warm-up and overlapping-lookback dependence.
research_meaning.limitations: Historical descriptive evidence only; no IID, causality, prediction or trading inference. Use the existing index case source binding and missing-tolerant policy without imputation, silent filtering, shortened horizons or provider fallback. No arbitrary stocks or futures.

planning_constraints: Resolve every required research input explicitly before G4 can pass or G5 execute. G1 can run independently of market inputs and credentials.
Discover actual admitted capabilities before composing a workflow. Task permission cannot expand Research, Statistics, Dataset, Snapshot or HTTP boundaries.

Before execution persist the full explicit validated plan/preview, selected public surface, operation order, analysis requests, resolved inputs, authorization and evidence/output plan as same-Run artifacts. Freeze workflow before invocation; a changed workflow needs a new Run because creation workflow/inputs are immutable.

Choose a surface whose published constraints permit the complete requested computation; never silently truncate dates, change horizon or alter the population. Preview legality is not live-data readiness.

HTTP currently limits both POSTs to 8 jobs, 4 analyses per job, 93 inclusive calendar days per window, H <= 20, 128 coordinates per spec, 128 request_id characters and 64 KiB body. A single 2010-2026 HTTP ResearchPlan is unsupported.

Public Python ResearchPlan/execute_batch has no HTTP size caps or acknowledgment field; it still enforces complete semantic preflight, upstream/calendar legality and availability. Long-history live readiness was not proven by WB-01 or by WB-02 G1.

Do not split HTTP calls and merge results as if equivalent to a single computation: quantiles, frequencies, sample accounting, coverage, dependence and provenance require an explicit future design and acceptance. WB-02 implements no partitioning, aggregation or long-window execution.

Preserve full historical goals such as 2010-2026 as requested inputs. Future G4/G5 must establish a legal complete-window surface and verify actual live history including warm-up or explicitly report the blocker; do not claim current executability.

G2 and G6 are intentionally deferred in this MVP and recorded SKIPPED with explicit reasons; this satisfies only their current deferral disposition, never authentication or visualization readiness. G3/G4/G5 have no WB-02 implementation or outcomes.

Dependencies are Task-owned prerequisites for evaluating later checks; G1/G3/G4/G5 require PASS before dependent checks proceed. G3 permits G2's explicit MVP SKIPPED disposition only after G1 passes. Intentional G2/G6 deferrals may be recorded independently of prerequisite success: SKIPPED does not evaluate a check or claim dependency satisfaction. A G1-only Run does not complete the research Task.
expected_outputs: WB-02: deterministic raw G1 JSON with actual HTTP/OpenAPI observations, explicit status/reason and finite timeout; preserved same-Run artifact and retrievable Gate outcome.

Future research: frozen validated workflow and full original objective, actual capability invocations/results/failures, statistical method/spec/results and units, subject/H/window/formula, population/coverage/warm-up/dependence/provenance, output locations and honest limitations. No fabricated results for unexecuted Gates.
Explicit report of G2/G6 deferral, G3/G4/G5 unexecuted state and any long-history blocker.
acceptance_criteria: G1 passes only from an actual compatible OpenAPI response with the four expected Research operations/operationIds and same-Run preserved readiness evidence; port reachability or lab doctor exit alone is insufficient.

Deterministic isolated HTTP tests cover compatible API, stopped backend, wrong service, malformed/incompatible OpenAPI, timeout, correct Run ownership/retrieval, deferred Gates and no market/cache side effects.
Real launched backend smoke when environment permits, using an isolated port if occupied; no Tushare credentials or Research execution required.
Future G4/G5 acceptance must prove complete historical objectives such as 2010-2026 under the selected public surface without assumed partition equivalence or unproven live-data availability.

gates.name: Backend Ready
gates.criteria: PASS iff the actual read-only checker observes HTTP 200 JSON OpenAPI compatibility as defined in BACKEND_READY.md, and its raw result is preserved as same-Run evidence. Attempted connection, timeout, HTTP, JSON or compatibility failures are FAIL with explicit reason. Invalid target/timeout prevents a request and is BLOCKED. No process identity or market-data readiness claim.

gates.name: Authentication
gates.criteria: Deferred in the current MVP: SKIPPED with reason that the current loopback backend has no authentication and G2 implementation is deferred. Never PASS or imply access security; future authentication needs an approved design/version.

gates.name: Capability Discovery
gates.criteria: Future implementation: actual published capability discovery preserved in this Run, supported index case and constraints confirmed, no inference of live readiness. PASS requires actual evidence. WB-02 performs no G3 check and records no outcome.

gates.name: Workflow Planning and Persistence
gates.criteria: Future implementation: explicitly resolved research inputs and authorization, actual capability-composed full-window legal workflow and pure preview, exact workflow persisted/frozen before execution with same-Run evidence. Long-history surface/data gaps remain explicit blockers; partition/merge equivalence cannot be assumed. WB-02 records no outcome.

gates.name: Execution
gates.criteria: Future implementation: invoke only the authorized frozen workflow/public operations, preserve actual results, failures, population/coverage/provenance and artifact locations; success requires all requested computation and analyses, with no fabricated, truncated or silently aggregated results. Verify complete long-history and warm-up availability or report failure/blocker. WB-02 records no outcome.

gates.name: Visualization
gates.criteria: Deferred in the current MVP: SKIPPED with explicit visualization-deferred reason. Never PASS or claim a rendered result; future implementation needs an approved design/version.
